diagnosis: TOTPDeviceDeactivateView handles deactivation of TOTP multi-factor devices by lookup of device_id. The query TOTPDevice.objects.filter(id=device_id) fails to scope the lookup to request.user. An authenticated attacker can supply any user's MFA device ID to delete their registered authenticator, stripping 2FA protection from victim accounts or forcing account lockout.

DELETE /api/mfa/devices/totp/84/ HTTP/1.1

Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1Ni...
Accept: application/json
